 9. Based on your PES statements what would be your nutrition
Rx and goals for intervention?
Rx: Nutrient recommendation: 2300 kcal/day; d/c caﬀ eine;
and reduce foods associated with GERD. Incorporate physi-
cal activity into lifestyle daily.
Goals: weight loss though decreased daily caloric intake and
increased physical activity; decrease symptoms of heartburn
Intervention: Increase patient’s knowledge of foods/
beverages/eating habits that may trigger heartburn; edu-
cation on energy content of foods/beverage and energy 
expenditure of physical activity.
• Education on how to read nutrition labels for fat and 
calorie content of purchased food; provide handout on 
fat and caloric content of foods.
• Instruct client on suitable substitutes for high-fat food 
items (lean meat products such as chicken breast, turkey 
breast, and egg whites instead of sausage, beef, whole 
eggs, and meatloaf; grilled or baked options instead of 
fried; and limiting the use of gravy and sauces).
